Un esame negativo va letto con la stessa:
A negative exam must be read with the same care as a positive one: the goal is to say “nothing” with confidence, without inventing findings (false positives) and without stopping too early.
Method: scroll through the whole volume in the lung window, one lung at a time, from apex to base; follow every round image in the neighboring slices (a vessel continues and branches, a nodule appears and disappears); check the places where nodules hide: apices, paramediastinal regions, behind the heart, bases near the diaphragm, under the pleura.
This CT comes from the LIDC-IDRI collection, in which 4 thoracic radiologists read every exam in two rounds: none marked any nodules, not even below 3 mm.
Vaso: continua e si ramifica. Nodulo: co: Vessel: continues and branches. Nodule: appears and disappears. No nodule = say so with confidence.
Esame negativo per noduli: nessun nodulo: Exam negative for nodules: no nodule (neither ≥ 3 mm nor < 3 mm) marked by the 4 radiologists of the LIDC-IDRI collection.
